s1.desc: a living room with a cream couch, a glass coffee table and an arched wooden front door, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: an igloo house interior with curved ice-block walls

beats.text: Pax sits on the couch with his feet out, looking toward the closed front door
Polly pushes the door open and stands in the doorway holding a small red purse, her eyes closed
Polly opens her tired, drooping eyes while Pax looks over at her from the couch

spans.notes: couch and table edges identical f0 vs f27

spans.view: with a small white bench and an arched wooden front door

beats.text: Polly stands by the open door holding a small red purse while Pax waddles in from the left toward her
Pax takes the purse from Polly's flipper, leaning his face close to hers, and sets it on the bench behind them
Pax steps around in front of Polly as the door swings shut behind him
Pax leans in and presses his face against Polly's cheek
Pax scoops Polly up into a tight hug, her feet lifted off the floor, both with eyes squeezed shut and blushing cheeks
Pax holds Polly up in his flippers and shuffles to the left, both now looking ahead with open eyes and rosy cheeks

beats.text: Pax stands by the open door in his necktie with a black briefcase at his feet, his eyes drooping wearily
Polly waddles in from the left with her flippers raised to her face in concern
Polly reaches out a flipper to touch Pax's arm while he looks back at her
Polly clasps her flippers together with blushing cheeks as Pax turns toward her

Pax and Polly hug tightly with their eyes shut, swaying together
Pax and Polly open their eyes and keep hugging as they shuffle toward the left edge
